# Carousel

Figma: [07j. Carousel](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=69-951) · Family: 07 Cards & Lists · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-01-01

A horizontally scrolling set of slides with a peek of the next, plus a page-indicator. Slides come in Standard (media + text card) and Hero (full-bleed) types at three sizes; the indicator supports Dots and Bars. Use it for onboarding, featured deals and promos. Direction (LTR / RTL).

Reference image (every variant, labelled): `knowledge/examples/components/carousel/reference.png`

### PageIndicator

Carousel page control showing position among up to 5 slides as dots with a pill active or segmented bars. Also reused as the scroll-snap indicator.

Level: atom · Part of: Carousel, ScrollContainer

Use when:
- Under a Carousel or snap-scrolling rail (Style=Dots for a few slides)
- Short ordered onboarding sets (Style=Bars)

Don't use when:
- Paged data: use Pagination
- Flow progress: use Stepper or ProgressBar

Accessibility: Expose 'Slide 2 of 5'; if dots are tappable each is a button with a label; mirrors in RTL.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Style | `style` | variant | Dots, Bars | Dots |
| Active | `active` | variant | 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 | 1 |

### Carousel / Slide

One carousel slide: Standard media-over-text card or Hero full-bleed media with overlaid text, in three sizes.

Level: molecule · Contains: Content · Part of: Carousel

Use when:
- Slides inside Carousel (Type=Standard for tips or featured content, Type=Hero for promos and onboarding)

Don't use when:
- Deal cards in a strip: use CardDeal
- Project update posters: use NewsCard / Poster

Accessibility: Hero overlay text must meet contrast over the darkened media; images need alt or be decorative.

### Carousel

Horizontal peek strip of slides with a PageIndicator, for browsable featured content, promos and onboarding where the peek signals more.

Level: organism · Contains: Carousel / Slide, PageIndicator

Use when:
- Featured deals, tips or learning content on home (Type=Cards)
- One big promo or onboarding sequence (Type=Hero)
- Paired with a Section header that offers See all

Don't use when:
- Complete or comparable lists: use List, ActionList or a Table
- Critical content users must not miss: show it inline
- Project update posters: use NewsCard / Poster Carousel

Accessibility: No auto-advance; provide tappable indicator or arrows besides swipe; first slide on the right in RTL.

| Type | `type` | variant | Cards, Hero | Cards |

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

A carousel shows a few browsable slides and peeks the next to signal more. Use it for onboarding, featured/promoted content and hero deals - not for complete or comparable lists (use List / ActionList) and not for critical content a user must not miss. Always pair the peek with a page-indicator so position stays clear.

### Composition

Carousel composes Carousel / Slide (media + Content) in a clipped strip with a PageIndicator. The slide reuses the Content atom; the indicator tracks position.

Carousel / Slide

PageIndicator

Carousel

### Slide types

Standard - a media-over-text card for browsable content. Hero - a full-bleed slide with text overlaid on the media, for promos and onboarding.

Standard

Hero

### Sizes

Sm / Md / Lg control slide width and media height - match the size to how prominent the content is.

Sm

Md

Lg

### PageIndicator styles

Dots for a few slides (≤ ~6); Bars for a clearer sense of progress through a short, ordered set.

Dots

Bars

### Direction - LTR & RTL

In RTL the first slide sits on the right with the peek on the left, and the active indicator mirrors to the trailing edge.

LTR

RTL

### Code examples

Flutter usage of Carousel.

### Featured cards carousel

```dart
SafqahCarousel(
  type: CarouselType.cards,
  size: SlideSize.md,
  peek: 0.12,
  indicator: IndicatorStyle.dots,
  slides: featured.map((f) => CarouselSlide.standard(
    media: NetworkImage(f.image), title: f.title, description: f.subtitle,
    onTap: () => context.push(f.route),
  )).toList(),
)
```

### Hero carousel

```dart
SafqahCarousel(
  type: CarouselType.hero,
  indicator: IndicatorStyle.bars,
  slides: promos.map((p) => CarouselSlide.hero(
    media: NetworkImage(p.image), title: p.title, description: p.subtitle,
  )).toList(),
)
```

### Usage - Do & Don’t

Do

Use Cards for a browsable set (featured deals, tips) and Hero for one big promo - peek the next slide + show the indicator.

Don’t

Don’t put essential or comparable content in a carousel (prices to compare, settings, long lists) - use a List instead.

Do

Pair the carousel with a Section header (title + “See all”) so the region is labelled and has a full-view jump.

Don’t

Don’t auto-advance important content or rely on swipe alone - provide tappable dots/arrows and avoid surprise motion.
